# `repo.get`

Show a repository

Repo home. Renders the default-branch tree with the README. Deleted repos read 404 except for their admins.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie repo get`
- MCP: `repo_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
